question: An engineer is configuring AAA authentication on a Cisco MDS 9000 Series switch. The LDAP server is located under the IP 10.10.2.2. The data sent to the LDAP server should be encrypted. Which command should be used to meet these requirements?
theory: The ldap-server host command's enable-ssl keyword causes the Cisco MDS switch to establish a secure SSL/TLS session with the specified LDAP server before sending any bind or search request, encrypting all authentication data exchanged with that host. This directly satisfies a requirement to encrypt LDAP traffic, whereas configuring a key or a nonstandard port alone does not enable transport encryption. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 20 - AAA, LDAP)
